answer_1.quote: Abstractive text summarization takes one or more documents as input and aims at generating an accurate and coherent summary from it.
answer_1.outputs: coherent summaries covering pre-selected highlighted spans

answer_2.quote: To measure content preservation we apply the metric between the generated text and the highlighted content ... ROUGE

answer_4.quote: To further evaluate the highlights' effect, we manually assess LED H and LED NH on two levels: (1) faithfulness of the generated text and (2) coverage of the highlighted spans in the system summary.
answer_4.guideline: We conducted two manual experiments ... to determine whether the summary unit is mentioned in the document (TP) or not (FP).
